# Prospeo

Prospeo provides B2B person and company search, enrichment, and verified contact data through its REST API.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/prospeo/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Enrich Companies** (read-only): Match 1-50 companies and correlate outcomes by caller-generated identifier.
- **Bulk Enrich People** (read-only): Match 1-50 people and correlate every outcome by a caller-generated identifier.
- **Enrich Company** (read-only): Match one company and return its full profile.
- **Enrich Person** (read-only): Match one person and return profile, company, and verified contact data.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Return the connected Prospeo team's plan, remaining and used credits, team size, and quota-renewal date.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search Prospeo's company database with typed practical and advanced filters.
- **Search Filter Suggestions** (read-only): Resolve canonical Prospeo filter values for locations, titles, technologies, industries, codes, and advanced company fields.
- **Search People** (read-only): Search Prospeo's person database with typed person and company filters.
